title: Controllers & assignments UI
description: No UI for footswitch/EXP/controller assignment (engine has CLI patch ops since core 0.58). Parity: FS bypass assign (latching/momentary, merge/replace), EXP bypass (position/wait/toe/heel), MIDI bypass, param->controller learn, min/max drag incl reverse, sources (stomp/ext-FS/triggers/EXP/MIDI/XY), stomp label+LED colour, swap stomps, clear, XY controller+rubber-band. Manual: live/bypass-and-controller-assign.

title: Snapshots management UI
description: device live follows snapshot switches but has no snapshot EDITING UI. Parity: 8 snapshots/preset; per-snapshot capture of block bypass + snapshot-controlled params + tempo; enable/disable snapshot control per param (white-value toggle); per-block Snapshots-Set-Bypass exclude; rename+color; copy/paste snapshot; swap; Discard-Edits mode. Engine ground already solved (dense @enabled, value==active, snapshot-bypass assignment). Manual: live/snapshots. See docs/parity/stadium-app-parity.md.

title: Signal-flow editor parity (device live chain editor)
description:
Bring the `device live` chain editor from "read-the-structure, turn-the-knobs" up to the Stadium Edit app's full SIGNAL-FLOW EDITOR.

CURRENT STATE: device live renders the loaded tone as a signal chain (every block, inputs/outputs, parallel lanes between split/merge), every param a knob/switch/list, bypass per block, live writes heard immediately, hardware Save, follows the device, undo/redo, adjective-search knob highlighting.

GAP (what the Stadium editor does that we can't): no structural editing (add/remove/move/copy-paste blocks), no model browser / model swap, no split/merge/parallel creation, no dual-cab 2nd model, no input-source / output-level selection in-UI, no mono<->stereo conversion, no Focus View deep editors (amp lens/XY morph, cab mic placement + IR plot, graphic EQ drag, comp gain-reduction meter), harness settings (Trails) hidden.

Full parity checklist (blocks add/remove/move, model browser, parallel routing, dual-amp/dual-cab, inputs/outputs, mono/stereo, Focus View) lives in docs/parity/stadium-app-parity.md -> "EPIC — Signal-flow editor parity".

Manual: manuals.line6.com/en/helix-stadium/live/ signal-path-routing, display, the-focus-view, matrix-mixer.

This is the "editor bead" to take into a design session first. The design session should decompose this into child issues AFTER resolving the model decision below.
design: BLOCKING DESIGN DECISION (resolve first). device live is device-bound: every control is a live OSC write to the edit buffer. The Stadium app edits a preset structurally whether or not sound is produced. Structural editing was left out partly because it is UNKNOWN whether the Helix live protocol (2001/2002/2003) supports add/remove/move-block live. helixgen already has an offline path for structure: .hsp mutate + patch verbs + device copy. Three candidate models: (1) LIVE-ONLY structural ops over the protocol - risk: may be unsupported, needs a protocol SPIKE first (can the device add/remove/move a block live and ack it?); (2) DUAL-MODE: same UI edits the on-disk .hsp via the engine for structure/deep-editors and pushes, params stay live - reuses mature mutate path, cost is reconciling 'edit buffer' vs 'editing a file'; (3) HYBRID: live for params/bypass, offline-.hsp-then-reload for structure - simplest, but a visible 'apply structure' step breaks seamlessness. START THE DESIGN SESSION WITH THE PROTOCOL SPIKE; its answer picks the model and determines which parity items are even feasible.
acceptance_criteria: A user can build a preset's signal chain from empty to multi-path / multi-block / dual-cab, with model selection, entirely in device live - no .hsp hand-edit, no HX Edit. Structural edits persist via the existing Save/copy model and round-trip cleanly (device to-hsp <-> library) with no fidelity loss. Parity items the live protocol genuinely cannot do are documented as won't-do with the reason, not left silently missing.

title: helixgen UI → Helix Stadium Edit app parity (+ library)
description: Umbrella epic. Bring the 'helixgen device live' browser workspace to feature parity with the Line 6 Helix Stadium Edit application (the Mac/Windows desktop editor), plus the on-disk .hsp + IR library management the Stadium app has no equivalent of. Full enumeration, epic map, and the design-ready editor brief: docs/parity/stadium-app-parity.md (main checkout). Source of truth: manuals.line6.com helix-stadium 'live' rev (app v1.4 / fw v1.4). Children are the per-area epics/issues; start with the Signal-flow editor.

title: Preset / librarian management parity
description: Overlaps the existing library drawer. Gaps beyond today: templates (+folders), favorites (import/export .hls/.hsf), clones/proxy-cloning library (2048, categories, folders), batch-color, full import/export (.hsp/.hlx, setlists as one file), reorder-renumbers-MIDI-PC, preset notes/clip/search. Decide helixgen-library-first vs device-librarian-mirror. Manual: live/presets, live/librarian-view.

title: Matrix Mixer / outputs UI
description: Per-output matrix layer (1/4\"/XLR/Phones), channels (paths, song tracks, click, USB, Bluetooth, Aux), level/pan/mute/solo, per-output global EQ, reset. Larger/newer surface; lower priority unless owner uses multi-out routing. Manual: live/matrix-mixer.

title: IR management parity
description: Drawer already pushes/renames/deletes device IRs and owns the on-disk IR library (more than the Stadium app). Gaps: import WAV (auto-convert 48k/32f/mono), up to 2048 slots, folders, export, unresolved-on-delete handling, boot-reindex note. Manual: live/librarian-view (Cab IRs).

title: Global EQ UI
description: Three global EQs (1/4\", XLR, Phones), independent of presets. Pairs with the editor EQ Focus View. Manual: live/global-settings (Global EQ view).

title: Global settings / I/O / routing UI
description: Global Settings 8 categories (Ins/Outs, Switches/Pedals, Displays, Preferences, Songs, Tempo/Click, MIDI, Date/Time). Many are hardware-global not per-preset: decide how much belongs in a preset-centric editor vs a separate device-settings pane. Manual: live/global-settings.

title: Command Center UI
description: Per-preset command assignments. Sources (stomp A/B, EXP, toe, XY, Instant 1-16, ext stomps, triggers), categories (Preset/Snap, Song, Looper, Utility, Ext Amp, MIDI bank/prog/CC/note/MMC, Hotkey), actions (press/release/hold/toggle), wait, snapshot-controlled command params, copy/paste/clear, label/colour. Engine models MIDI CC/Command Center (plugin 2.26). Manual: live/command-center.

title: Song View / Showcase (WON'T-DO — owner-ratified 2026-11-24)
description: Backing-track / stem-split / playlist feature needing a purchased microSD; large surface, little overlap with helixgen tone-authoring. Flag explicit wont-do unless owner wants it. Manual: live/song-view. Owner ratified won't-do 2026-11-24; parity epic complete without it.

title: Device / utility UI
description: Connect dialog, firmware updates, remote-access PIN, rename device, licenses, account. helixgen covers discovery/backup/restore via CLI. Low UI priority. Manual: live/main-menu.

title: Tuner / tap tempo / tempo panel UI
description: Needle/strobe tuner, reference pitch, string offsets, tuner in/out; tap tempo, note-value, tempo panel. Mostly a live read/display surface. Manual: live/tuner.

title: Matrix Mixer write path (read surface found: server.mixer.state)
description: 2026-11-23 discovery sweep: the Matrix Mixer per-strip plane is READABLE over the LAN as the single structured property server.mixer.state (vol_/pan_/mute/solo/src_/name per channel; AUX/BT/Click/Count/Home paths/layer mixes). Corrects the prior 'not a property / wont-do' verdict (a dsp.matrix* glob missed a server.* blob). Remaining work is the WRITE path only: test /PropertyValueSet server.mixer.state (likely a variant/structured codec like dsp.globaleq.*), confirm on HW in a scratch value with read-back, then add a device/client.py method + `device matrix` verb. Reads need no capture. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-23-undocumented-ops-discovery-findings.md

title: Library / slot / setlist sidebar (Stadium-style)
description: Follow-on to the canvas+focus editor (shipped 0.92.0). Bring the library drawer toward the Stadium app's preset SIDEBAR: a per-setlist slot grid (1A-8D) showing what's in each slot, drag a preset slot-to-slot, and fold the on-disk .hsp library into the same surface (assign a library tone onto a slot; reconcile drift). Owner named this the next focus after editing. Manual: live/presets, live/librarian-view.

title: Canvas/focus UX pass for IR + Command Center + Global EQ panes
description: The IR/librarian (81v.7/9), Command Center (81v.4) and Global EQ (81v.6) panes shipped functionally but predate the canvas+focus reframe (0.92.0). Investigate giving them the same Stadium-parity visual treatment (category icons/accents, tile/row affordances, consistent chrome) so the whole editor reads as one system. Owner deferred these from the editor-UX reframe to track here.
